notes.title: Skully is 35% off as a part of Modus' Heads Will Roll Sale
notes.content:
From now until October 22, get 35% off of Skully on Steam! This is a part of Modus Games' Heads Will Roll promotion that sees the head-spinning good times of Skully and Rock of Ages 3 on sale at the same time! 

[h2]Skully[/h2]
On a mysterious remote island, a skull washes up on shore and is reawakened by an enigmatic deity. Dubbed Skully, the newly reanimated being has been summoned to intervene in a war between the deity’s three siblings, whose quarrel jeopardizes the island they call home.

Deal available here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1249110/Skully/

[h2]Rock of Ages 3[/h2]

Competitive tower defense meets arcade action and gets rolled up with ACE Team’s quirky, Monty Python-esque humor into one giant, creative game for the ages. This time around, you can even make your own levels!

Deal available here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101360/Rock_of_Ages_3_Make__Break/

But hurry, this deal is barreling downhill and will be gone before you know it.
